Daily

Every day · ~46 min total

Weekly

Every Tuesday · 45–60 min
  • Run cfb_edge_data_pull.py — real CFBD/ESPN/Odds API/bigballsdata pull for that week's games (5–10 min)

Monthly

First Tuesday of the month · 60–90 min

📁 Your Three Files
NCAA_Edge_Model_v1.html
The full model. Open in Chrome or Edge browser. Runs entirely locally — no internet required after loading. All tabs, matchup engine, props matrix, DFS, and backtest live here.
cfb_model_data.json
Live data file generated by the Python script. Contains EPA values, NGS player metrics, injury statuses, and upcoming games. Load this each week via the Data & API tab.
cfb_edge_data_pull.py
Python script that pulls real CFB data from CFBD, ESPN, The Odds API, and bigballsdata, and generates the JSON. Run weekly (Tuesday after games) from Command Prompt. Requires: requests (pip install requests).
📂 Keep all three files in the same folder: Desktop → NCAA Edge Model
🔧 One-Time Setup
1
Install Python Dependencies
Open Anaconda Prompt and run:
pip install pandas requests openpyxl pyarrow beautifulsoup4
Only needs to be done once. If pyarrow fails, the script still works — NGS parquet data will be skipped and fallback stats used.
2
Get Your Free Odds API Key
Go to the-odds-api.com → sign up free → copy your API key. Free tier = 500 requests/month. NFL prop markets use ~3-5 requests per game day.
3
Enter API Key in the Model
Open NCAA_Edge_Model_v1.html → go to 🔄 Data & API tab → paste your Odds API key → click Save. Key is stored in your browser and persists across sessions.
4
Load the Sample Data File
In the 🔄 Data & API tab → click 📂 Load cfb_model_data.json → select the file. This activates the live EPA engine and SP+-based prop adjustments. Without it, the model runs on 2025 static baseline data (still usable).

Refresh Live Data (Python)

cd "C:\Users\gator\OneDrive\Desktop\NCAA Football"
python cfb_edge_data_pull.py
Takes 2-5 minutes. Pulls CFBD API stats, EPA/SP+ values, advanced metrics, injuries, and schedules. Outputs a fresh cfb_model_data.json.

3
Fetch the Week's Games + Lines
Use the Date Range bar at the top of the screen → click This Weekend (covers Thu–Mon) → click ⚡ Fetch. This pulls ESPN game schedules (free, no key) and bet365 lines via Odds API simultaneously.
4
Run Matchup Analysis
⚡ Matchup tab → select Away + Home teams → set weather conditions (auto-hides for dome stadiums) → adjust injury sliders if needed → click UPDATE MODEL. Review factor bars, WR vs CB matchup grid, and the model narrative.
5
Review Props Matrix
🏈 Props tab → filter by position (QB/RB/WR/TE/K) → sort by Edge % → STRONG tier (🔥 8%+ edge) = highest conviction plays. Use Combo Builder: double-click any stat toggle to add it to a combo, then click ⚡ Calc Combo.
6
RB/DFS Lineup Building
🏃 RB/DFS tab → select DraftKings or FanDuel platform → enter salaries in the table → sort by DFS Value (pts per $1,000) → Value Leaders board auto-populates. Filter by archetype (Receiving/Dual/Balanced/Rushing) to match your lineup strategy.
7
Build Your Card + Parlay
🎯 Best Bets tab → top STRONG props auto-rank here → click + Parlay on any prop to add it to the Parlay Builder → click Calculate to see American odds and $100 payout.
🏈 Pre-Season / Week 1 Setup
The model runs on 2025 prior-year baseline until Week 1 of 2026 is played. This is correct — prior season data is the best predictor for Week 1 projections.
1
Keep Python at SEASON=2025 for Week 1
Open cfb_edge_data_pull.py → confirm BASELINE_SEASON = 2025 and CURRENT_SEASON = 2026. After Week 1 is played, change both to 2026 for live data.
2
Update Roster Changes
🔄 Data & API → Pre-Season Setup → Roster Override → select team → enter new QB/RB/WR1/TE names and DVOA adjustment → click Save Override. Overrides apply instantly on top of the 2025 baseline. All overrides persist between sessions.
3
Import 2026 Rookies
Pre-Season Setup → 2026 Rookie Import → enter name, position, team, draft pick #, college, conference, and season stats → click + Add Rookie. Draft pick drives usage tier projection (e.g., pick #4 QB → ELITE tier → 95% usage applied to college stats).

For bulk import from your Prospect Analyzer: click 📊 Import from Prospect Analyzer JSON → paste JSON array → click ⚡ Import.
4
Portal / True Freshman Translation
Portal transfer projections use: prior-team stat × origin-conference adj × 0.85 portal factor × usage %. True freshmen have no prior CFB stats to scale, so they run on usage-tier share alone until live games establish a baseline.
Conference tiers (origin-team strength): SEC 1.00× · Big Ten/12 0.92× · ACC/PAC 0.82× · AAC/MWC 0.70× · FCS 0.48×
Blending: 0 CFB games this season = 100% preseason projection. After 3 games (5 for QB) = 100% live-season data.

📊 Key Metrics Glossary
Off/Def DVOA
Defense-Adjusted Value Over Average. Measures efficiency relative to a league-average team. Positive off DVOA = better than average offense. Negative def DVOA = better than average defense. Source: Football Outsiders. Scale: roughly -30% to +30%.
EPA/Play
Expected Points Added per play. Measures how many points a team adds (or allows) above expectation on each play. More predictive than yards or points. Loaded from nflverse via Python script. Each +0.1 EPA/play ≈ +0.94 pts per game vs average.
Pass EPA / Rush EPA
EPA split by play type. Pass EPA weighted ×5.5 and Rush EPA ×3.9 in the scoring formula (reflecting 57%/43% play frequency). Teams with elite pass EPA (Mahomes, Burrow) project significantly higher than overall EPA alone.
Red Zone %
Touchdown percentage on red zone trips. League average ≈ 57%. Each 1% above average adds ~0.12 pts to team projection. Critical for TD prop projections.
3rd Down %
Conversion rate on 3rd down attempts. League average ≈ 40.5%. Each 1% above adds ~0.4 pts to projected score. Range in 2024: BAL 51.2% (best) to NE 33.2% (worst).
CPOE
Completion % Over Expectation. How much better/worse a QB completes passes vs model expectation based on target depth, coverage, etc. Each +1% CPOE adds ~0.18 pts to team projection. Burrow +4.2%, Mahomes +3.1% in 2024.
IAY
Intended Air Yards per attempt. How deep a QB targets on average. Higher IAY = more aggressive/vertical passer. League avg ~7.0. Each +1 IAY above average adds ~3.5 pass yards/game to projection.
RYOE
Rush Yards Over Expected per attempt. How many yards a RB gains above what an average back would get with the same blocking. Barkley +1.82, Henry +1.21 in 2024. Each +1 RYOE adds ~3.2 rush yds to projection.
Separation
Average yards of separation at the point of the catch (WR/TE). League avg ~2.4 yds. Each +0.5 yds above avg adds ~4% to receiving yards projection. Loaded from NGS via JSON.
Air Yards Share
A receiver's % of their team's total intended air yards. Indicates target quality (deep targets vs short dumps). High air yards share = WR is getting downfield opportunities. Used to adjust rec yards ceiling.
Role/Volume (RB)
Framework dimension score 0-100 from your RB rankings. Drives rush yards projection. Score 100 → ~120 rush yds/game. Score 50 → ~60 rush yds/game. Based on Attempt%, 10+ attempt%, snap%, and clear feature-back role.
Receiving Role (RB)
Framework dimension score 0-100. Drives rec yards + reception projections. Score 100 → ~65 rec yds/game. Based on Route%, Target%, YCO, and Receiving/Dual archetype classification.
Explosiveness (RB)
Real 2025 PFF elusive rating (yards created after contact/broken tackles relative to opportunities). Replaces the old NFL-era "Age Curve" concept, which relied on draft-proximity age data that has no clean CFB equivalent.
Divisional Adj.
When both teams are in the same division: HFA reduced from +2.5 to +1.5 pts, and -1.25 pts applied to each team's score (-2.5 off total). Defenses have full film on familiar opponents. Auto-detected — gold badge appears in matchup.
🎯 Edge Tiers Explained
🔥 STRONG
8%+ edge — Highest conviction. Model projection diverges significantly from the posted line. Historical hit rate in backtest: ~62%. Play these with full confidence. Good parlay anchors.
⚡ MED
4-7.9% edge — Solid play. Worth betting but size down vs STRONG. Historical hit rate ~54%. Stack with STRONG plays for parlays.
📊 LEAN
1.5-3.9% edge — Small edge, use as tiebreaker or GPP DFS. Below break-even for -110 juice. Historical hit rate ~47%. Only play with correlated context (matchup + scheme align).
SKIP
<1.5% edge — No meaningful edge over the market. Avoid. These appear in the matrix for reference only — they do not show in Best Bets.
ATS edge threshold: Model spread must diverge ≥3 pts from the market line to show an ATS pick in the Betting tab. At ≥3 pts divergence, the model went 29-8 (78.4%) against the spread in the 2024 backtest.
💡 Pro Tips
💡
Best Bets Convergence = Strongest Plays
When a player shows STRONG in the Props Matrix AND their team has a favorable scheme matchup in the Def Matchups tab AND the team has a high-scoring game projection in the Matchup tab — that's triple convergence. These are your highest-confidence bets.
💡
Weather kills totals — not spreads
When outdoor games have wind >20 mph or temp <32°F, the model correctly reduces totals but the spread effect is minimal. Target unders in those games, not necessarily the underdog.
💡
Divisional games: fade the total, not the favorite
The model's -2.5 pt total adjustment for divisional games is conservative — real data shows divisional totals go under at ~58%. Divisional favorites still cover at near-normal rates (52%). Focus divisional plays on unders.
💡
Use the Backtest to calibrate your confidence
Filter the 2024 Backtest to ATS Correct results and look for patterns — which team types, spread sizes, or game situations the model nails vs misses. The Deep Analysis tab has specific callouts.
💡
RB archetype matters for DFS vs betting
DFS: Prefer Dual and Receiving archetypes — they score in multiple categories. Betting (rush yds props): Prefer Rushing and Balanced archetypes — they get the volume that drives over hits. Receiving backs have high variance on rush yds props.
💡
Late-season roster rest = model blind spot
Weeks 17-18: teams with playoff seeding locked often rest starters. The model has no way to know this in advance. Check beat writers Thursday for lineup decisions before locking any Week 17/18 props or totals. The backtest showed this as the biggest source of misses.
💡
API request management
Free Odds API = 500 requests/month. Each ⚡ Fetch on a full week uses ~3-5 requests (one for game odds + one per prop market). Fetching props for 8+ games uses 8-12 requests. At ~16 game weeks, you have ~30 full fetches per month — enough for 2 per week with buffer.
